_comment: PNPT Procore Professional Services packages. Tools live at the PACKAGE level (with a position and an optional constraint), and each tier references which tools it includes via toolIds. connections describe canonical data flow between tools (direction: 'to' = source -> target dashed orange, 'from' = target -> source dashed black, 'both' = bidirectional solid orange — matching the ERP Connector Map convention). The renderer draws a node-link diagram and highlights the tools belonging to the currently selected tier(s). Verticals (GC/Owner/Specialty) gate which packages are available; per-vertical tool overrides can be added via tier.toolsByVertical or tool.names later. Tool display names follow Procore's point-of-view dictionaries where they differ: tools[].names = {owner, sc} overrides (gc = default name). Source: support FAQ 'What tool names and terms are different in Procore for general contractors, owners and specialty contractors?' - only officially documented renames are encoded.

tools.name: Cost Catalog
tools.description: Company-level library of unit costs, materials, and assemblies that feed into Estimates.

tools.name: Bid Board
tools.description: Track bid invitations and awarded bids; awarded bids can promote into project Commitments.

tools.name: Takeoff
tools.description: Quantity takeoffs from drawings; feeds quantities into Estimates.

tools.name: Estimating
tools.description: Build project estimates from takeoff quantities and Cost Catalog items; promote to Budget.

tools.name: Prime Contracts
tools.description: Upstream owner contract and its Schedule of Values. Source of project revenue value.

tools.name: Commitments
tools.description: Downstream subcontracts and purchase orders. Drives Committed Cost on the Budget.

tools.name: Budget

tools.description: Real-time view of committed, direct, and forecasted cost against the original/revised project budget.

tools.name: Direct Costs
tools.description: Non-commitment costs (labor, expenses, AP) that post as actuals against the Budget.

tools.name: Change Events / Orders
tools.description: Track potential scope impacts (Change Events) and finalize them as PCO/PCCO/CCO change orders.

tools.name: Invoicing
tools.description: Manage both upstream (owner) and downstream (subcontractor) progress billings against contracts.

tools.name: Reports
tools.description: Custom + canned project reports across all financial tools.

tools.name: Analytics Setup
tools.description: Default Procore Analytics dashboards for financial tools (Enterprise tier).

tools.name: Lien Waivers & Compliance
tools.description: Collect and verify conditional/unconditional lien waivers from subs before releasing payment.

tools.name: Payment Management
tools.description: Schedule and disburse payments to subcontractors through Procore Pay.

tools.name: Payment Approval Process
tools.description: Approval workflow that authorizes payment release once lien waivers and compliance items are confirmed.

connections.description: Prime Contract value seeds Budget revenue.
Commitment values populate the Committed Cost column of the Budget.
Direct Costs post against budget line items as Actual Cost.
Change Events drive the Revised Budget; approved Change Orders update it.

Approved Commitment Change Orders (CCO) modify the Commitment value.
Owner Invoices bill against the Prime Contract SOV (managed in Invoicing).
Subcontractor Invoices bill against the Commitment SOV (managed in Invoicing).
Reports surface Budget, cost, and contract data.

Approved payments flow back into Invoicing.
